predictions: Aw, geez… yet another kinda sorta ok week last Wednesday. I'm really starting to stack those up pretty deeply already. The 15-8 that I posted takes me to 73-40 (64.6% correct) for the season, which is… fine. And while I've completely turned it around in F division (with two straight 4-0 weeks), but I've effectively traded away any success in D division to get there (only 1-5 in D in the last two weeks). So no I'm sub-0.500 in both B and D divisions to this point, which is pretty sad. I need to rebound.

Match of the week: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Off Constantly- Reboot. Constantly stumbled without Tufillaro last week, or else this would be the double-undefeated showcase showdown. Meanwhile, the Bandits dropped a huge bomb on DD-214 last week and took over the point lead as well as having a match lead. I saw OC being in this spot, but the Bandits have surprised me a bit. The surprise continues, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ Rippin Darts. Despite only winning two matches at the oche so far, the Nein-ers are the only team within a loss of Rippin, so this is certainly the current G marquee matchup. Is this a Whitley-present week, or a Whitley-absent week? Hmmm… It's entirely possible that Rippin wins either way. So, I'm with Rippin, 14-10.

Match #3: (F Div.) Village Idiots @ Sofa Kings. If Sofa hadn't taken one on the chin last week, this banger would've been in the running for match of the week. Still a big one though, as no F team is undefeated and both of these are in the top half of the division. I think this revisiting of last season's big G matchup goes the way of the Idiots, barely. 13-11.

Match #4: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ The Global Element. The huge Element-Bullies matchup looms next week, but I think the biggest hurdle between now and then sits right here. Liver has super-high-end talent and can take out either of the top two on pretty much night. I'm sticking with my guys to take care of business, but it's never easy. Element, 15-9.

Match #5: (B Div.) Double In, Uber Out @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Serious and Blind are a match ahead, so this battle for 3rd is almost potentially an early elimination match. Both these teams have rebounded from 1-2 starts with a couple straight wins each, and I'm guessing that it's Matt Tab who makes it 3 in a row. My first correct Tab pick? 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Show Me Your Tips. Show Me only has two more wins than losses, and they are only averaging 13.5 points. And they sit alone atop the C craziness. I'm guessing they'll take this one too, but this goes the distance. 13-11.

Match #7: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ The Bullies. All that stuff I wrote for match #4 to the left? All that applies here too, with just a slightly lower expectation of the upset. It could happen, in pretty much a blink. But I think The Bullies are rolling and take this, 17-7.

Match #8: (F Div.) Shoot-Da-Bull @ Shark Shooters. At first glance, this looks like a battle for last in F. And…. it is. But these teams are only three wins out of first, so maybe this could also be the start of a charge upward for the winner. Shoot-Da-Bull, 13-11.

Match #9: (A Div.) Armed & Hammered @ Darty Minds. A first A win of the season is in line for somebody here. And don't act like any win at all in A division isn't a big deal. Most people reading this might well never have one of those. I'll go Armed here, 14-10.

Match #10: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Hump Day! After just five weeks, it's already starting to feel like the Ducks are flying away in E. But if they land, the winner here is likely to be the first to have a chance to take a shot. I'll take Hump Day as the challenger, 14-10.

Match #11: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Nine Lives. Just a run- of-the-mill battle between a 2-3 and a 2-2 team. Boring, right? Not in C! These two could be first or last in like two weeks! Niners, 13-11.

Match #12: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Irish Ton. It's crossroads time for these 0.500 teams. Time to make a move or it becomes time to try to avoid the cellar battle. I'm guessing Machine gets it, 14-10.
